web-guide-idea-92.audience: People who enjoy a friendly participatory singing game.
web-guide-idea-92.offer: Host a clear, welcoming game using material you may share. Good rules and fair turns make the experience worth joining.
web-guide-idea-92.steps.0: Explain the rules and organise turns.
web-guide-idea-92.steps.1: Run short rounds with a lively but inclusive pace.
web-guide-idea-92.steps.2: Finish with a friendly recap and next theme.
web-guide-idea-92.equipment: A phone, clear audio and a prepared list of permitted material. Use turns to avoid call-latency confusion.
web-guide-idea-92.returnReason: Rotate themes and team combinations so regulars get a fresh game.
web-guide-idea-92.promotion: Explain the language and rules, with no need to promise prizes.
